name: Progress
summary: Progress bar: determinate, or indeterminate when the total is not known yet, with a supporting detail and a tone.

a11y.apg: The APG pattern is Meter/Progressbar: role="progressbar" with aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax, and aria-valuenow only when the value is known. Indeterminate omits aria-valuenow, so the bar never announces a 0% it does not mean. A text detail travels in aria-valuetext ("64%, 2.3 MB/s") and its drawn copy is hidden from the screen reader, so it is heard once. No keyboard interaction — a progress bar reports, it does not accept input. That is what separates it from Range, which is a slider.

props.name: value
props.description: Percentage, 0 to 100. Clamped once and used for both the fill and aria-valuenow, so what is drawn and what is announced cannot drift apart. Without a value the bar is indeterminate (AN-07): a piece two fifths wide runs across the track — HeroUI's numbers, 1.5 s — instead of a 0% that reads as stalled. With reduced motion it does not run: the whole bar, dimmed, never a still piece that would read as 40% done.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the bar. Not drawn. Without it the screen reader announces a bare number with no subject.

props.name: detail
props.description: Supporting text above the track, on the end side — HeroUI's ProgressBar.Output: speed, time left, bytes. Small, muted, tabular figures. As text it also becomes aria-valuetext; anything else (a link) stays where it is for the screen reader to reach.

props.name: tone
props.type: brand | neutral | success | warning | danger | info
props.description: What the fill colour means — the same closed list as Button's tone. Paused is neutral; failed is danger. Every tone keeps 3:1 against the track in both themes, except brand in the light theme (the brand gold is a fill, ADR-0054).

props.name: className
props.description: Goes on the outer box, the one that holds the detail and the track.
